_miss.title: Drop me on something
_miss.text: Drag me onto anything you're curious about, like a button, a light or a message.

_tuning.title: Still being tuned
_tuning.text: This one is still being tuned. Its proper help words are on the way. You can still try it, or ask Simmie what it does.

help-orb.title: Your helper
help-orb.text: That's me. Drag me onto anything and I'll explain it in plain words. Or tap me, then tap the thing you're curious about. Tap 'Change how I look' in any help box to make me an owl, a car, a moon or any emoji you like.

pw.title: Your password
pw.text: Type your chat password here to open your private chat with Simmie. Keep it secret, and I never look at what you type.

pw-toggle.title: Show or hide
pw-toggle.text: Shows the password you typed so you can check it, then hides it again. Only use it when nobody is looking over your shoulder.

login.title: Open chat
login.text: Opens your chat once the password is typed in. If it says no, check for a typo and try again.

kid-logo.title: Your logo
kid-logo.text: Tap it to see it big, with its own music and little birds. Tap it again, or tap Edit, to change it. Changes go straight onto your page.

lock.title: Lock
lock.text: Closes your chat and asks for the password again. Use it when you walk away from the screen.

ask-dad.title: Ask Dad
ask-dad.text: Starts a message to Dad in the message box. His phone buzzes so he knows you want him. Nobody else sees it.

log.title: Your messages
log.text: Your chat with Simmie. Only you and Simmie can read it, and it's locked with your password.

tty.title: Simmie's terminal
tty.text: Fun facts scroll past here. Tap it to type a message to Simmie, then press send.

lights.title: Status lights
lights.text: SENT lights up when your message went, FRESH when the chat is up to date, LINK when the page can reach Simmie, and DAD when Dad has something for you.

phi-reset.title: Reset what this page learned
phi-reset.text: The page learns your pace on this device only, like how quickly you tap. This wipes it and reloads the page. Nothing was ever sent anywhere.

phi-pause.title: Pause motion
phi-pause.text: Stops things moving all over the page. Press it again to start them. Your device remembers your choice.

weather.title: The weather
weather.text: The weather outside in Perth right now, as a little picture.

typing.title: Waiting for Simmie
typing.text: Simmie is writing back. It can take a little while, so you can keep doing other things.
